The company invested Rs 65.55 crore in CSR that year, in education, childcare, community health, rural infrastructure and daily sustenance. Examples: Project Disha, eye care with Shri Harihar Maharaj Charitable Trust (Rs 500 lakh): 50 eye camps in five districts of Gujarat, about 16,000 people screened, 2,000 surgeries and 6,000 free eyeglasses over 2022-23 and 2023-24. Cancer treatment at the National Cancer Institute with Dr Aabaji Thatte Seva Aur Anusandhan Sanstha (Rs 1,000 lakh): about 22,000 patients treated in 2022-23.
